$comment: Static per-kind artifact defaults, applied only when the project has no artifact_kind_policy row for that kind (DECISIONS.md §8.1 D-A9 / OI-06-03, 06-O3; ratified D-S46-Q1). Media types are exactly the types MediaSniffer.HasSignature accepts (06.3.1-T2.2).

log.reason: D-A9 names a log kind that the 00 §7 closed list does not have

rules: A project row always supplies media_types and capture_enabled and wins for both; a kind default applies only while no row exists.
effective_max_bytes = min(row.max_bytes, kind.max_bytes) for a kind that has a default; a kind without a default uses the row value as is.
No project row and no kind default: 422 kind_disabled (fail closed).
Sensitivity of a defaulted kind is ArtifactSensitivity.ForKind(kind); a project row may set default_sensitivity instead.
request_body_max_bytes caps the POST /v1/artifacts/upload-url request body before deserialisation; over the cap is 413 payload_too_large.
